text: A meteorite drops [a sentient parasite|origin|from another world] near Wheelsy, South Carolina, and it takes over Grant, a wealthy local, who swells into a tentacled thing and [turns a local woman into a breeder for his young|threat|monsters and creatures]. His wife Starla notices first. When the bloated woman bursts, slug-like larvae [leap into the mouths of the townsfolk|rules|it gets inside you], binding them to Grant's hive mind, while Grant still [longs to win Starla back|wants|a lover to possess].
